Perfect! All tests pass. I've added the new `overdueInvoices` function and comprehensive tests.

## Summary

Added `src/reports.js` with the `overdueInvoices(invoices, asOf)` function that:
- Filters invoices with status `'issued'` or `'partially_paid'` whose `dueDate` is before the `asOf` date
- Returns an array of `{ number, customerId, dueDate, daysOverdue, due }` objects
- Sorts by `daysOverdue` descending (most overdue first)
- Calculates `daysOverdue` using `daysBetween` and `due` using `balanceDue`

Added `test/reports.test.js` with 31 tests covering:
- Edge cases (null, empty invoices)
- Status filtering (excludes draft and paid invoices)
- Date filtering and sorting
- Correct calculations with payments and various terms
- Large datasets

All 270 project tests pass.
